architecture.review: Informational threshold: nine members in a 21-line existing exception. portability.enforcement: RESULT: PASS (15674 reviewed executable-source findings unchanged)

invariants: Actual Core and MAF registration before and after the saved Process stop makes zero provider calls and preserves the original cancelled journal.
The late-registration case preserves the complete saved detail including timestamps, journal, logs and metrics after completed root recovery.
Verified admission cancellation carries the original typed session; a foreign session or matching error code without evidence still produces ordinary failure.
Atomic current-state publication rejects stale success, failure and repeated cancellation over a saved background cancellation.

Supporting remote-owner tests use independent File store and cancellation registry, actual provider-dispatch journal transitions and the actual Core stop protocol after releasing the original dispatch lease.
Normal execution and approval continuation preserve owner-cancellation classification without wrapping it as persistence failure.
No new production type, partial owner or project reference; MAF and Process implementation remain unchanged.
corrections: Baseline two-case actual-producer test reproduces one stop-first failure against signed production 2a53d6826; registration-first passes.
First production build missed the Models namespace import for typed session evidence; fixed before downstream builds and final execution.
limitations: Remote-owner supporting tests are not operating-system process restart proof.

Full automatic worker/HTTP activation, held inherited publication, bounded owner I/O, live/legacy fairness, whole-journal capacity, refresh/settings, remaining writer coverage and final E2E remain open.
